Almost three-quarters of the firms say they already use generative AI in their operations, but about half estimate that no more than 10% of their workforce uses it at least once a week, and only 6% put that share above 25%. Improving employees' access to information is the main motivation, rated important by more than 90% of users, closely followed by producing content, developing software and engaging with customers; around half of users also see reducing headcount as an important motivation. The firms are among the largest in the euro area, so the share is far above estimates for all firms, and it is not plotted on the overview. The [ECB Blog of 28 March 2025](https://www.ecb.europa.eu/press/blog/date/2025/html/ecb.blog20250328~60c0a587f7.en.html) summarises the same results.
